jobs.title: Multichannel Strategy Senior Manager
jobs.description:
Please note this job advertisement is only available in Spanish. To view the job, select ‘Español - ES’ from the language selector in the page menu.
Purpose of the role
Define, design, and mobilise the bank’s multichannel strategy to ensure an optimal, future-fit distribution footprint—maintaining a relevant physical presence in the geographies and catchment areas where it creates the greatest customer and commercial value—while improving the efficiency, simplicity, and profitability of traditional channels (branches and contact centres) and accelerating adoption of digital and self-service channels (mobile app, web, ATMs, and deposit machines).
This role leads cross-functional collaboration to shape and embed differentiated service models by segment and location, integrating end-to-end customer journeys across physical and digital touchpoints to strengthen relationships, increase satisfaction and engagement, and drive sustainable cost optimisation through customer digitalisation and transaction migration towards lower-cost channels—without compromising service quality, accessibility, or regulatory requirements.

Main Activities
- Define and govern the end-to-end multichannel strategy: Develop and maintain the vision, principles and short/mid/long term roadmap aligned to growth, efficiency, customer experience (CX), risk and compliance, and establish the governance model, tracking cadence and initiative prioritisation criteria.
- Design and optimise the physical footprint (branches, ATMs, CDMs and retail partners): Co-define the optimal geographic coverage and format based on demand, business potential, segmentation, competition and accessibility, and co-drive openings, relocations, closures or transformations supported by business cases and customer transition plans.
- Define service models by segment and location : Co-design differentiated service models (advisory vs transactional, lite branches, hubs, remote service), and define roles across branch, contact centre and digital, including SLAs and customer-and-sales routing rules.
- Orchestrate cross-channel customer experience improvement : Design integrated journeys (onboarding, servicing, sales and after-sales) with seamless handovers across channels, simplifying processes and removing friction and operational rework.
- Drive channel efficiency and customer migration: Increase adoption of lower-cost digital and self-service channels while optimising assisted channels, set migration targets by transaction type, and ensure accessible alternatives for vulnerable or non-digital customers.
- Align stakeholders and ensure execution: Coordinate key teams across Business, Technology, Operations, Data, Marketing, Product, Risk/Compliance and Channels to deliver key initiatives, managing dependencies, risks and frontline adoption across branches and contact centres.
- Influence cross-functional execution and governance: Mobilise business, operations, technology and channel teams to deliver strategic initiatives through effective governance, senior stakeholder management and executive-level influence.
- Build a high-performing strategy team and a data-driven culture: Develop a team capable of translating customer insights and business data into actionable decisions and plans, and embed an evidence-based approach to prioritisation and performance management.

The role holder needs to have knowledge and experience in the following areas:
Technical and Functional Expertise
- Channel strategy, customer journey design, and customer experience management.
- Banking operational processes across branches, contact centers, and digital channels.
- Transaction migration models and operational efficiency frameworks.
- Financial and customer experience KPI design and interpretation.
- Customer-centered design, agile methodologies, and data-driven decision-making.
- Knowledge of local regulations (CNBV, Banxico) and banking control standards.

Experience
- Minimum 8 years in banking, consulting, or fintech roles related to transformation, channels, or digital strategy.
- Proven track record leading multidisciplinary teams.
- Demonstrated experience in large-scale channel optimization or digital transformation programs.

Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Economics, Engineering, Marketing, or related fields.
- Master’s degree preferred in Business, Digital Transformation, or Strategy.
- Certifications in Agile / Scrum / Design Thinking / CX Strategy (preferred).
- Advanced English (able to present and negotiate with regional or global stakeholders).

jobs.description:
If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC, and fulfil your potential - whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Technology Infrastructure Strategy Lead .

Enterprise Infrastructure (EI) sits at the heart of HSBC’s Chief Technology Office (CTO) – operating, maintaining & transforming the on-premise technology infrastructure used by HSBC to host applications & services. EI’s product catalogue spans servers, storage, databases, mainframe, middleware, internal cloud & automation technologies amongst others.

You’ll lead strategic planning & operating rhythm for the Enterprise Infrastructure leadership team. You’ll shape and drive the infrastructure agenda across priorities such as resilience, modernisation, service quality, financial discipline, and risk management - turning strategy into clear transformation plans and measurable outcomes.

You’ll act as the “glue” across teams: aligning stakeholders, accelerating decision-making, and ensuring the leadership team stays focused on the work that matters most for colleagues and customers who rely on stable, secure, and high-performing technology every day.

As an HSBC employee in the UK, you will have access to tailored professional development opportunities and a competitive pay and benefits package. This includes private healthcare for all UK-based employees, enhanced maternity and adoption pay and support when you return to work, and a contributory pension scheme with a generous employer contribution.

In this role you’ll:
- Lead the annual and multi-year strategy cycle for Enterprise Infrastructure, defining the vision, priorities and strategic roadmaps
- Translate Group Technology and business strategy into clear, actionable infrastructure transformation initiatives
- Develop high-quality executive materials, including strategy packs, decision papers and leadership updates
- Own the leadership team’s operating rhythm, including regular reviews, strategic deep-dives and governance forums
- Track delivery of critical portfolio priorities, identifying dependencies, bottlenecks, risks and decisions needed to maintain momentum
- Partner with Transformation & Change and the Chief Operating Office to support investment planning, budget management and spend transparency
- Assess infrastructure capacity and capability requirements, supporting workforce planning and resource-allocation decisions
- Drive productivity, simplification and continuous improvement across processes, tooling and organisational design, while building alignment across senior stakeholders

To be successful in this role you should meet the following requirements:
- Ability to shape infrastructure strategy, roadmaps and transformation plans

- Understanding of core domains such as compute, storage, databases, cloud and hybrid operating models
- Strong experience of Infrastructure on premise stragey whining Data Centres
- Experience tracking delivery, dependencies, risks, issues and benefits across complex portfolios
- Confident producing clear strategy papers, decision materials and concise leadership updates at Exco level
- Capability in investment planning, budget management, prioritisation and spend transparency
- Analytical and decision-making skills, data-driven approach to identifying priorities, evaluating trade-offs and managing risk
- Skilled at bringing together diverse perspectives, creating alignment and accelerating decisions

jobs.title: Senior Corporate Banker Middle Markets
jobs.description:
The Senior Corporate Banker (Subdirector) leads client relationships, drives business growth, and ensures the delivery of high-quality service for a Middle Markets portfolio within the consumer sector.
Acting as the primary senior point of contact, the role owns coverage strategy and execution, mobilizing internal teams to deliver integrated solutions and maintaining strong portfolio governance.  The role primarily covers medium-sized companies, family-owned businesses, sponsor-backed companies, and local or regional corporate groups, often working directly with owners, CEOs, CFOs, and treasurers.

The role involves analyzing financial performance and sector dynamics, leading sales objectives, and driving the acquisition of new clients. Success requires balancing relationship depth, profitable growth, credit discipline, and speed of execution across a focused portfolio. Core responsibilities include:

● Relationship Management: Building and maintaining strong relationships with both existing and prospective clients, serving as the primary point of contact and senior sponsor for key relationships. Developing trusted relationships with owners, CEOs, CFOs, and treasurers, and understanding both the company’s financial needs and the wider objectives of its shareholders.

● Sales and Growth: Driving revenue by identifying cross-selling opportunities and acquiring new clients; leading client planning, pipeline management, and prioritization to improve wallet share and returns. Identifying opportunities across lending, cash management, trade finance, foreign exchange, interest-rate hedging, deposits, and other core banking products. Maintaining strong prospecting discipline and converting local and regional opportunities into sustainable relationships.

● Portfolio Leadership: Leading the preparation and presentation of client reviews, financial analyses, and risk assessments; ensuring proactive monitoring, early-warning identification, and disciplined remediation actions where required. Maintaining close visibility of liquidity, leverage, cash-flow generation, working capital, collateral, shareholder support, and refinancing needs. Escalating deterioration early and taking practical actions to protect asset quality.

● Cross-Functional Coordination: Orchestrating cross-functional teams (Risk, Compliance, Legal, Operations, and product partners) to ensure timely origination, structuring, approvals, execution, and onboarding/implementation—balancing speed-to-market with strong governance. Coordinating primarily with local and regional product, credit, and operational teams, while ensuring that solutions remain proportionate to the client’s scale and complexity.

● Operational and Control Oversight: Ensuring timely processing of credit facilities, loans, and documentation, while maintaining high standards across KYC, due diligence, and internal policies and external regulations. Taking ownership of documentation quality, onboarding progress, covenant tracking, account conduct, and timely resolution of operational issues across a portfolio where relationship responsiveness is a key differentiator.

● Monitoring: Overseeing overall portfolio health to identify potential risks, ensure adherence to internal policies and external regulations, and protect HSBC’s risk appetite and reputation. Monitoring concentration risk, sector exposure, related-party transactions, informal support assumptions, and customer or supplier concentration.

Required Skills and Qualifications

● Education: University degree in Business, Finance, Actuarial Science, Engineering, or related field.

● Postgraduate degree (desirable): MBA, Management, Risk Management, Finance.

● Experience: 6+ years in corporate banking, institutional sales, or senior client relationship management, with demonstrated accountability for revenue delivery, credit outcomes, and portfolio governance. Experience covering medium-sized companies, privately owned groups, entrepreneurs, or regional corporates is particularly valuable.

● Communication: Excellent interpersonal and verbal/written communication skills, with executive presence and the ability to influence at CFO/Treasurer/Owner level. Demonstrated ability to build credibility with business owners and decision-makers who may combine corporate, family, and shareholder perspectives.

● Languages: Intermediate English proficiency.

● Analytical Skills: Strong ability to analyze financial data, market trends, and client performance, translating insights into actionable coverage and risk strategies. Strong understanding of the consumer sector, including key industry KPIs, competitive dynamics, and macroeconomic drivers. Additional emphasis should be placed on cash-flow quality, working capital seasonality, debt-service capacity, collateral, shareholder liquidity, and the reliability of management information.

● Sales and Relationship Skills: Strong consultative selling capability, with the ability to identify unmet needs, deepen wallet share, develop local market intelligence, and turn relationship knowledge into actionable opportunities.

● Credit Skills: Sound understanding of credit assessment, financial spreading, covenant analysis, facility structuring, collateral, guarantees, and early-warning indicators.

● Proven track record (desirable): Origination and/or execution experience in syndicated loans, DCM, and structured finance, including coordination with specialist teams and leading client dialogue through execution milestones. Experience in bilateral and club lending, asset-based lending, working-capital facilities, trade finance, acquisition finance, or privately negotiated transactions may be equally relevant.

● Tools: Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint), with the ability to produce high-quality client materials, credit presentations, and sector updates. Ability to simplify complex financial information into clear recommendations for clients, credit committees, and senior management.

The implementation of the Expected Credit Loss (ECL) segment of IFRS 9 (International Financial Reporting Standards) involved implementation of new models for ECL calculation, designing of a new calculation engine (ICE)  Impairment Calculation Engine and implementation of a new operating model and controls. The implementation also entailed establishment of IFRS 9 Operations (erstwhile IPAC (Impairment Production & Analysis Centre)), a joint Risk and Finance Centre of Excellence, domiciled within the Finance Operations to calculate, analyze, report, and support the disclosure of ECL.
- The Global IFRS 9 team is a joint venture between the Global Finance and Risk teams and works in close collaboration with both Finance and Risk. The IFRS 9 Operations team is responsible for the calculation and reporting of ECL for almost all entities within the HSBC group
- The role holder will lead the delivery of Expected Credit Loss (ECL) results for all the Wholesale / Retail sites. The role holder is required to navigate through a constantly changing environment and deliver the ECL results within challenging timelines.

In this role, you will:
- Own the end-to-end IFRS 9 ECL process for the specific Wholesale/Retail vertical, covering calculation, analysis, reporting, disclosure support, and emerging accounting and disclosure changes.
- Build and maintain effective relationships with Risk GPO (Global Process owner) teams, CROs, (Chief Risk Officer) CFOs (Chief Finance Officer), Financial Controllers, Financial Reporting, Regulatory and Risk leads globally, regionally and locally.
- Support IFRS 9 requirements, maintain a robust control environment, adhere to SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) controls, Group accounting policies, data, process and system rules, and manage audits effectively.
- Support strategic IFRS 9 initiatives, including Finance Data Solution (FDS), Future State Architecture (FSA), RegX and Basel 3.1 reforms.
- Engage, motivate and develop a high-performing team through resourcing, training, development and retention.
- Own and deliver the IFRS 9 runbook for ECL calculation, analysis and reporting, and support IFRS 9 disclosures, external financial statements, publications and FinRep Credit tables.
- Identify and interpret accounting, regulatory and disclosure changes, implementing required uplifts to data, processes, systems and controls.
- Manage change impacts through effective assessment, testing, implementation and timely delivery.
- Act as a trusted Finance and Risk partner by managing senior stakeholders, resolving concerns, maintaining communication channels, and ensuring positive engagement with no escalations.
- Deliver IFRS 9 transformation through FDS, FSA, RegX and Basel 3.1, promote continuous innovation, streamline processes, implement technology for manual and error-prone activities, and track opportunities through completion.

To be successful you will:
- Experienced Finance/Risk professional with 15+ years in financial services domain with a proven track record of leading Finance / Risk operations.
- Understanding of credit risk, regulatory and accounting concepts including IFRS 9, PD (Probability of Default) , LGD (Loss Given Default) , EAD (Exposure at default)  etc is mandatory
- Strong technical knowledge including the ability to understand and interpret upcoming accounting changes and market trends on IFRS 9 and key disclosure requirements.
- Exposure to emerging innovation and transformation concepts with a proven track record of driving innovation
- Strong understanding of the concept of data including sourcing, lineage, and controls. Ability to understand business strategy, translate them to team goals and lead a team of qualified professionals to deliver on the goals.
- Ability to communicate complex information in a succinct and credible manner, both orally and written, directly with Senior Management. Ability to navigate through ambiguity and lead and influence colleagues across the HSBC Group.
- Ability to work in a dynamic environment and adapt to frequent and multiple changes. Ability to manage a complex process within resource and time constraints.

#LI-DNI

Full time employment, Monday – Friday, 40 hours per week. Pay Range: $200,000.00 to $210,000.00 per year.

Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, business, management or a related field and 5 years of progressive, post-baccalaureate related work experience.

Must have 5 years experience in Investment banking.

and sector specific valuation models.

FINRA Series 63 and Series 79 licenses.

Vous plaçant au cœur de la relation avec les grands investisseurs institutionnels, ce poste est une occasion unique d’avoir une exposition à l’ensemble des métiers de la Banque de Financement et d’Investissement, d’enrichir votre culture technique et financière, et de contribuer à la mise en œuvre de la stratégie d’HSBC, groupe international de premier rang.

jobs.description:
Ready to turn AI experimentation into auditable Technology Operations outcomes?
Why HSBC
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world. Guided by our purpose of opening up a world of opportunity, our ambition is to become the world’s most trusted bank globally, putting customers at the heart of everything we do.
The Role
AI 4 Technology sits within the Chief Technology Office (CTO) and is responsible for the strategy and responsible adoption of artificial intelligence across HSBC’s technology environment. As AI for Technology Operations Lead (Director level role), you’ll own the strategy, adoption and governance of AI across Technology Operations, improving governance flow plus effectiveness and efficiency. This is a newly created GCB3 role within CTO Platforms - AI 4 Tech, based in London with direct reports. You’ll align multiple initiatives into a coherent programme, setting the operating model and foundations needed for responsible adoption of AI within Technology Operations in a regulated environment. The focus is on measurable outcomes across service resilience, operational efficiency and technology delivery - supported by clear assurance, controls and monitoring. Success means scaling high-impact solutions while keeping the engineering standards, architecture and governance strong enough to stand up to audit and regulatory scrutiny.
What you'll be doing
- Set the strategy for AI adoption and governance across Technology Operations, improving governance flow, effectiveness and efficiency
- Consolidate duplicated and competing AI initiatives into a single, coherent programme with clear investment priorities and delivery roadmaps
- Shape sustainable AI-powered operating models that support HSBC’s long-term technology transformation ambitions
- Establish governance, assurance, control and model-monitoring frameworks that enable responsible and auditable adoption in a regulated environment
- Build and manage multidisciplinary teams of AI specialists, data scientists, engineers, architects and operational SMEs including developing talent through coaching and career pathways
- Manage Enterprise Architecture across multiple domain areas to deliver programme outcomes without creating avoidable technical debt
- Set engineering standards for the development, testing, deployment, monitoring and retirement of AI solutions including effective MLOps practices
- Govern technology suppliers and delivery partners with accountability for value, quality and control effectiveness
- Translate complex technical concepts into clear decisions, outcomes and recommendations for senior stakeholders

What we're looking for
- Bring senior leadership experience in banking, financial services or another highly regulated industry
- Demonstrate proven delivery of enterprise-scale technology transformation and organisational change
- Show experience defining and executing AI strategy, investment priorities and delivery roadmaps across complex stakeholder groups
- Apply strong practical knowledge of AIOps, MLOps, machine learning, Generative AI, large language models and AI agents
- Demonstrate a strong understanding of technology operations, operational resilience and technology risk
- Establish AI governance, assurance, control and model-monitoring frameworks that support safe adoption and audit scrutiny
- Bring familiarity with cloud platforms, observability tooling, automation frameworks and platform engineering
- Build and run multidisciplinary teams across engineering, architecture, data and operations, with a demonstrable commitment to inclusive talent development
- Govern technology suppliers and delivery partners, coordinating effectively across Technology, Data, Cybersecurity, Risk and business teams
- Communicate effectively at executive level, translating complex technical topics into clear decisions, outcomes and recommendations

Shaping responsible AI at scale
This Director level role gives you the scope to build a coordinated, enterprise-wide approach to AI adoption across HSBC’s internal Technology organisation. This newly created London-based Director role provides global COO leadership across the Capital Markets & Advisory (CMA) Global Sector teams as well as the definition and delivery of CMA’s simplification and AI agenda. Reporting into the Global COO team and partnering closely with the Global Head of Sector, this role translates strategy into execution and strengthens decision-making through trusted data and commercial insights. - Establish audit-ready governance and controls and maintain oversight of operational information regulatory and other non-financial risks across regions
- Manage regulatory engagement for Global Sectors in partnership with Business Risk, Regulatory Compliance and relevant stakeholders

- Bring strong knowledge of and preferably experience with investment banking products with the ability to interpret market and client trends into an enablement roadmap
- Apply a practical understanding of AI enablement in a regulated environment including data governance, use-case lifecycle and control expectations
- Demonstrate experience shaping technology requirements including user journeys user stories acceptance criteria data needs and operating model impacts
- Communicate complex topics clearly for executive audiences including decision trade-offs and recommendations with advanced PowerPoint and Excel capability
- Influence and align senior stakeholders across businesses and regions and take decisions through to execution without relying on formal authority

Job content:
- - Investment process and CIO House View implementation (Taiwan onshore) - Develop and implement Taiwan onshore investment strategies, asset allocation guidance (SAA/TAA) and thematic ideas across asset classes for Private Banking and Premier Wealth clients.
- Contribute to the global/regional investment process to formulate value-adding portfolio strategies and commercially viable High Conviction Themes (aligned to the CIO House View).
- Drive the local CIO-led end-to-end process via a Taiwan investment committee, ensuring consistent implementation across advisory and portfolio construction.
- Deliver frontline training on SAA/TAA, Core–Satellite framework and Portfolio Based Approach to strengthen investment advisory quality and consistency (“One Voice”).
- Contribute to the delivery of the Sustainable Investment Strategy, including sustainability-related themes and ESG investment initiatives.

- Multi-asset product f ulfilment and cross-asset collaboration - Drive cross-asset collaboration with Wealth Product teams to steer onshore product fulfilment planning and tactical investment idea generation in support of investment revenue growth.
- Identify best-in-class investment products to implement multi-asset allocation, investment themes and other tactical ideas for Taiwan onshore clients.
- Monitor investment performance of products used for asset allocation, themes and tactical ideas on both a standalone and portfolio basis; recommend adjustments where needed.
- Work closely with fund house partners and capital markets vendors to develop fit-for-purpose onshore solutions that implement CIO House View and High Conviction Themes

- Content creation and distribution (Mandarin & English) - Lead onshore investment content creation by leveraging Global/Asia CIO content and Global Investment Research to develop value-adding market analysis and investment narratives tailored to Taiwan client needs.
- Contribute local market insights into CIO publications (e.g., Daily/Weekly/Monthly Investment Insights, Quarterly Investment Outlook, Market Updates and High Conviction Themes materials).

- Provide Mandarin and English materials and training to enable holistic end-to-end client servicing for both Premier and Private Banking.
- Partner with relevant digital/content teams to enhance distribution via approved digital interfaces and platforms.

- Internal and external marketing / client engagement - Communicate CIO House View and High Conviction Themes effectively through onshore investment outlook events, client events, UHNW roundtables, collaboration events and 1:1 client meetings.
- Provide bespoke CIO advisory to UHNW/Family Office clients on asset allocation, portfolio strategy and market analysis.
- Build thought leadership and a visible public profile through proactive external marketing and media communication (subject to governance/approvals).
- Support Net New Money generation and new client acquisition through participation in client pitches, prospecting events and key client meetings.
- Drive internal marketing via weekly investment and/or morning meeting processes to ensure effective delivery of CIO views and product fulfilment plans to frontline colleagues.
- Ensure consistent “One Voice” communication and implementation of CIO House View across the end-to-end investment and advisory process.

Skills Requirement
- Significant experience in portfolio strategy, investment research, asset allocation and product selection within wealth management/private banking (depth commensurate with CIO seniority).

Job Summary
- The Manager, Business Operations will manage day-to-day broking back-office operations across trading support, clearing & settlement, risk operations, depository (DP), reconciliations, and client service . The role is hands-on and execution-focused, ensuring timely settlements, accurate reconciliations, strong controls, and regulatory compliance with SEBI, Exchanges, Depositories, and Clearing Corporations . You’ll work closely with Technology, Compliance, Finance, and front-office teams to drive operational stability and incremental automation.

Core Responsibilities & Duties
1) Trade Support, Clearing & Settlement
- Manage daily clearing and settlement activities with NSE Clearing / BSE Clearing ensuring timely fund flows and demat deliveries .
- Ensure accurate processing of pay-in/pay-out , settlement obligations, shortages, auction handling, and exception resolution.
- Track settlement timelines and ensure adherence to exchange/clearing corporation cut-offs.

2) Margins, Collateral & Risk Operations (Operational Execution)
- Support accurate computation/collection of margins, MTM, and exposure ; monitor margin shortfalls and coordinate timely actions.
- Maintain daily controls around risk checks, limit breaches, and operational risk events; escalate issues with clear root-cause and fix plan.

3) Reconciliations & Controls
- Own daily/periodic reconciliations including exchange , client ledger , bank , depository , and settlement-related reconciliations.
- Ensure breaks are investigated, evidenced, resolved within defined TATs, and reported through appropriate governance.
- Maintain strong maker-checker controls, audit trails, and documentation aligned to internal policies and regulatory expectations.

4) Client Lifecycle & Service Operations
- Oversee operational processing for client onboarding, activation, and modifications , ensuring compliance with SEBI KYC, PMLA, FATCA/CRS requirements.
- Manage operational aspects of investor grievance handling in line with SEBI timelines , SCORES , and exchange mandates; ensure accurate responses and closure evidence.

5) Regulatory Reporting & Audit Support
- Prepare/review operational inputs for regulatory filings such as EOD reports, margin reporting, capital adequacy support packs, and audit responses .
- Support internal/external audits and regulatory inspections by providing accurate data, reconciliations, SOPs, and evidence packs.
- Ensure SOPs and process notes are current and reflect regulatory circulars and operational changes.

6) Technology & Process Improvement
- Work with Technology/Product teams on OMS/RMS/BO operational issues, UAT support, and production incident triage.
- Identify automation opportunities in reconciliations, statements, payout workflows, and settlement tracking; help define requirements and validate outcomes.
- Track operational SLAs, recurring issues, and drive closure through structured problem management.

7) Key Interfaces
- Internal: Compliance, Finance, Technology, Product, Risk, Client Service
- External: Exchanges, Clearing Corporations, Depositories, Banks, Technology partners

Mandatory Qualifications, Certifications & Experience
- Education: Graduate in Commerce / Finance / Business Administration/Engineering. MBA or equivalent preferred.
- Recommended Certifications:
- Mandatory NISM Series VII - Securities Operations and Risk Management
- Good to have: NISM Series-VIII: Equity Derivatives; NISM Series-VI: Depository Operation; NISM-Series-XXIV: AML and CFT Provisions
- Experience: Minimum 4+ years in stock broking operations, clearing, or depository functions,
- Domain Knowledge: Deep, functional knowledge of NCL & ICCL settlement processes, reconciliation, risk operations, collateral management, reporting, and back-office accounting software

Preferred Skills & Competencies
- Expert-level domain knowledge of broking back-office operations and regulatory requirements
- Deep familiarity with SEBI Master Circulars, Exchange operational rules, Depository Operating Instructions, and PMLA requirements
- Proven ability to scale high-volume broking operations with operational resilience
- Exceptional attention to detail and ability to work under strict deadlines
- Proficiency in risk management and internal controls
- Strong stakeholder management, vendor coordination, and cross-functional collaboration skills
- Experience working within large broking or financial institutions is a strong plus

•    Plan and control workload and workflow across the team, ensuring delivery is scalable, efficient and deadline-driven

•    Drive continuous improvement by identifying, recommending and implementing process and procedure enhancements in partnership with the Head of ETF Operations, and contribute to ad hoc projects as needed

You should apply if you have:
•    Strong product and industry knowledge of traditional funds, with specific expertise in ETFs and the ETF servicing lifecycle (issuers, APs (Authorised Participants) and other counterparties)

•    Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with a service-oriented, customer-focused approach

•    Strong control mindset: comfortable operating within internal controls, compliance expectations and operational risk frameworks, with a track record of escalating and resolving errors/complaints appropriately

Trade has been the foundation of HSBC since 1865, it is evolving fast and so are we. With our network, expertise, and solutions we’re placed to help clients make sense of emerging trends, risks, and opportunities by being the global connectors, innovative problem solvers and strategic partners.

jobs.title: Liquidity Sales Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
HSBC Deutschland ist Teil der HSBC-Gruppe, einer der führenden Geschäftsbanken der Welt.
Bei HSBC ist es unser Ziel, eine Welt voller Möglichkeiten zu eröffnen. Wenn Sie ein Teil unseres Teams werden, können Sie gleichzeitig Teil von etwas Größerem sein. Dabei werden Diversity & Inclusion großgeschrieben, denn HSBC vernetzt Sie mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen aus der ganzen Welt und ermöglicht es Ihnen, Ihre Zukunft aktiv mitzugestalten.
Wir suchen Mitarbeitende mit Persönlichkeit! Charaktere, die für unsere gemeinsamen Ziele einstehen und sich füreinander stark machen, während sie gleichzeitig überzeugende Lösungen für unsere Kundschaft finden. Wenn Sie bei Ihrem nächsten Arbeitgeber also scheinbar Unvereinbares miteinander vereinen möchten, heißen wir Sie bei HSBC herzlich willkommen.
Die Position Liquidity Sales Manager (m/w/d) ist am Standort Düsseldorf ab sofort zu besetzen. Hier helfen Sie das Geschäft der HSBC Global Asset Management (Deutschland) GmbH weiterzuentwickeln und auszubauen.

Die HSBC Global Asset Management (Deutschland) GmbH konzentriert sich als 100 % Tochtergesellschaft des Bankhauses HSBC Continental Europe S.A., Germany auf das internationale Asset Management für institutionelle Anleger, Firmenkunden, öffentliche Körperschaften und Finanzintermediäre. Gemeinsam mit den zum HSBC-Verbund gehörenden Investmentspezialisten entwickeln und vertreiben wir maßgeschneiderte Anlage- und Fondskonzepte für unsere Kunden im deutschsprachigen Raum und in Osteuropa.
HSBC Asset Management (AM) ist die Vermögensverwaltung der HSBC Group, eines globalen Finanzinstituts mit über 150 Jahren Tätigkeit an internationalen Finanzmärkten. Innerhalb der übergreifenden Investment-Management-Plattform verwaltet Global Liquidity mehr als 200 Mrd. US-Dollar an Assets under Management (AUM) und deckt Geldmarkt- sowie Short-Duration-Fixed-Income-Strategien ab. Als größter nicht-US-amerikanischer Liquiditätsmanager der Branche liefert Global Liquidity Lösungen für Institutionen, Staaten, den öffentlichen Sektor sowie multinationale Unternehmen in 10 Währungen. Das Financial Institutions Coverage Team verantwortet die Kundenakquisition und das Relationship Management für Banken, Versicherungen, Hedgefonds, Fintechs, Pensionsfonds und Asset Manager.

Die Position:
Vermarktung der globalen Liquidity Fonds-Palette von HSBC (Geldmarktfonds und Short-Duration-Cash-Lösungen) an Kunden aus dem Finanzbereich wie Banken, Versicherungen, Pensionsfonds und anderen institutionellen Anlegern in Kontinentaleuropa, mit primärem Fokus auf die deutschsprachige Region (DACH).

Ihre Verantwortlichkeiten
- Neukundenakquisition im Bereich Financial Insititutions
- Verantwortung für existierendes und Ausbau eines Kundenportfolios von innerhalb des Financial Institution Bereichs in Kontinentaleuropa und Generierung von Nettozuflüssen in die HSBC-Liquidity Fonds-Palette
- Identifizierung neuer Geschäftschancen bei Banken, Versicherungen, Asset Managern, Fintechs und anderen regulierten institutionellen Investoren und deren Umsetzung
- Hauptansprechpartner für bestehende FI-Kunden: Steuerung der täglichen Zusammenarbeit und Sicherstellung hoher Servicestandards
- Enge Zusammenarbeit mit der Institutional Coverage der HSBC Bank in Kontinentaleuropa zur Identifikation von Chancen im jeweiligen Kundenportfolio
- Zusammenarbeit mit Produktspezialisten, Portfoliomanagern sowie Legal/Compliance zur Ausgestaltung von Liquiditätslösungen gemäß Kundenmandaten und regulatorischen Anforderungen (z. B. Solvency II, UCITS, MMF Regulation)
- Repräsentation von HSBC auf Branchenkonferenzen, Kundenevents und Roadshows in der Region
- Aneignung eines tiefen Marktverständnisses zu europäischen Geldmarkttrends, regulatorischen Entwicklungen und Wettbewerbspositionierung
- Zusammenarbeit mit globalen Liquidity-Sales-Teams zur Sicherstellung konsistenter Kundenbetreuung und grenzüberschreitender Deal-Umsetzung
- Erstellung präziser Sales-Forecasts, Pipeline-Reports sowie CRM-Pflege

Ihr Profil
- Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung im Institutional Liquidity Sales oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle, idealerweise mit Geldmarktfonds, Liquiditätslösungen, Cash Management oder Fixed-Income-Produkten
- Etabliertes Netzwerk bei Finanzinstituten in Deutschland und/oder Kontinentaleuropa
- Fundiertes Verständnis von Cash- und Liquiditätsmanagement, regulatorischen Rahmenwerken (MMF Regulation, Basel III/LCR-Auswirkungen) und den Bedürfnissen institutioneller Investoren
- Ausgezeichnete Fähigkeiten im Beziehungsaufbau, in Verhandlungen und Präsentationen
- Relevante Lizenzen/Registrierungen gemäß deutscher/EU-Regularien (z. B. MiFID II Suitability)
- Sehr gute schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikations- sowie Präsentationsfähigkeiten
- Kundenorientierter Ansatz bei der Aufgabenbearbeitung
- Stakeholder-Management als zentrale Stärke; Teamfähigkeit ist zwingend erforderlich
- Starke zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten sowie die Fähigkeit, in einer Matrixorganisation erfolgreich zu sein und globale Teambeziehungen aufzubauen und zu pflegen
- Fließendes Deutsch und Englisch (weitere europäische Sprachen von Vorteil)

Zusätzliche Fähigkeiten, die von Vorteil sind („Nice to have“ / Skills & Zertifizierungen):
- Kenntnisse der Finanzmärkte, des makroökonomischen Umfelds, von Theorie, Trends, Tools und Strategien
- Kenntnisse und Bewusstsein für Liquiditätsfonds und individuell verwaltete Mandate, Investmentprodukte, Märkte und Geschäftsumfeld
- Nachweisbare Erfolge in einer ähnlichen Rolle innerhalb einer globalen Organisation sind ein zusätzlicher Vorteil
- Erfahrung im Einsatz von Technologie zur Verbesserung von Geschäftsergebnissen
- Praktische Kenntnisse von CRM-Tools wie MS Dynamics

Unsere Benefits
Die Gehaltsspanne für diese Position liegt bei 68.400,-- € – 95.000,-- €.

- Außertarifliche Eingruppierung: Für Rollen außerhalb der Tarifstruktur bietet HSBC verschiedene variable Vergütungsmodelle an, um der Vielfalt unserer Geschäftsbereiche, Rollen und Märkte Rechnung zu tragen. Wir bieten ein umfassendes und wettbewerbsfähiges Leistungspaket mit einer attraktiven betrieblichen Altersversorgung, Unterstützung für die Work-Life-Balance (einschließlich unseres Employee Assistance Program) sowie weiteren Benefits zur Förderung Ihres allgemeinen Wohlbefindens.
Darüber hinaus bieten wir:

Diese Anerkennung des Top Employers Institute belohnt unsere HR-Praktiken und erkennt HSBC als HR-Leader in Frankreich, Deutschland, Italien, Luxemburg, den Niederlanden, Polen, Spanien und der Schweiz an. jobs.description:
Ready to set the sales agenda for global trade solutions clients in Qatar?

Why HSBC

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organization’s in the world. Guided by our purpose of opening up a world of opportunity, our ambition is to become the world’s most trusted bank globally, putting customers at the heart of everything we do.

The Opportunity

This is a sales management role within Global Trade Solutions (GTS) focused on trade, supply chain and receivable finance for a portfolio of corporate clients.

The role exists to deliver revenue growth through working capital management products and services alongside structured trade solutions while deepening relationships and increasing wallet share.

You’ll shape and execute sales strategies for both existing clients and new-to-bank and new-to-trade opportunities. Working across senior bankers and partners in product proposition and sustainability you’ll convert client needs into clear proposals and closed deals. Success means sustainable commercial growth supported by strong pipeline management and efficient execution for complex transactions.

What you'll be doing

- Own sales outcomes for a Corporate portfolio across Trade, Supply Chain and Receivable Finance
- Grow revenue through working capital management products and services to maximise commercial profitability and relationship depth
- Strengthen wallet share across existing clients and expand penetration across group companies through additional GTS solutions
- Develop sales strategies to win new clients and generate new income including new-to-bank and new-to-trade opportunities
- Build and progress a robust sales pipeline from origination through pitch proposal and closure
- Partner with Senior Bankers in CIB and stakeholders across global and local teams to generate new leads and deepen relationships
- Set direction on market opportunity assessments and ensure solutions reflect trends and client requirements within the GTS product suite
- Coordinate with Client Services and implementation teams to ensure timely and efficient execution for complex clients

What we're looking for

- A full-time graduation degree of at least three years is essential for obtaining a Qatar visa and work permit. For degrees obtained outside the Qatar, valid attestations are also mandatory.
- Demonstratable substantial sales experience in global trade finance with a strong track record of pitching and converting opportunities into revenue is required.
- Bring deep knowledge of global trade finance including structured trade products and techniques market trends and the competitive environment
- Show experience originating new-to-bank or new-to-trade opportunities and growing wallet share across an existing Corporate portfolio
- Apply working knowledge of Credit and Risk including techniques to mitigate risk in structuring solutions
- Use strong communication presentation and negotiation skills to engage clients and internal stakeholders
- Partner effectively across Corporate and Institutional Banking – Global Trade Services product proposition and sustainability stakeholders to shape proposals and close opportunities
- Evidence effective prioritisation and pipeline discipline to meet critical deadlines across a varied client portfolio
- Bring Arabic language capability or equivalent demonstrable experience serving Arabic-speaking clients - Arabic is beneficial for the role

Sales growth in Global Trade Solutions

Global Trade Solutions has been at the core of HSBC since 1865 and today supports customers from SMEs to large corporates and multinationals with trade finance and risk mitigation solutions. This role puts commercial outcomes at the centre - building pipeline strengthening wallet share and converting complex trade needs into structured solutions. You’ll work across a global trade franchise that facilitates a significant part of global trade annually supported by over 5,000 trade experts worldwide. If you want a role where sales execution and client impact are closely linked this is a strong platform to do both.

jobs.description:
Ready to shape how CTOi manages technology controls and risk?
Why HSBC
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world. Guided by our purpose of opening up a world of opportunity, our ambition is to become the world’s most trusted bank globally, putting customers at the heart of everything we do.
The Role
The CTOi Head of Control Operations owns the control environment across CTO Infrastructure (CTOi) and evolves how controls are managed through proactive and data-based oversight. This role represents CTOi across key risk and control forums including the Technology RCMM chaired by the GCIO. You’ll partner with senior stakeholders across technology and the wider business to strengthen the technology risk and control framework and improve how issues are identified and addressed. The remit spans information security, infrastructure, applications and vendor management in a highly regulated environment. You’ll oversee a direct organisation of 170 people and manage an associated budget of USD 15m. Success means clearer control ownership, faster identification and closure of gaps and measurable improvements in control effectiveness and reporting.
What you'll be doing
- Own controls across CTOi and set a proactive, data-based approach to controls management and transformation
- Represent CTOi at risk and control forums including the Technology RCMM chaired by the GCIO
- Develop and maintain the technology risk and control framework aligned to enterprise risk strategy and regulatory requirements
- Establish policies and procedures across technology risk and control including disaster recovery, incident response and risk and security awareness training
- Identify and assess technology risks across information security, infrastructure, applications and vendor management
- Implement risk mitigation strategies and controls in partnership with technology teams and key stakeholders
- Monitor and report control effectiveness including the identification and resolution of control deficiencies and gaps
- Coordinate with operational risk, compliance and internal audit to manage technology risks in an integrated and consistent way

What we're looking for
- Bring substantial experience building and running technology risk and control frameworks in a regulated environment
- Demonstrate experience shaping policies and procedures for disaster recovery, incident response and security and risk awareness
- Show proven capability identifying and assessing technology risks across information security, infrastructure, applications and third-party providers
- Evidence delivery of effective risk mitigation strategies and control improvements with measurable outcomes
- Bring experience monitoring control performance, reporting to senior governance forums and closing control gaps
- Demonstrate strong stakeholder partnership across technology and business leadership including executive-level forums
- Show experience coordinating with second line risk functions, compliance and internal audit to align risk outcomes
- Bring experience managing budgets and resources for risk and control initiatives and working with vendors and partners

Strengthening CTOi Control Operations
This is a senior, Director level opportunity to shape how CTO Infrastructure governs controls and manages technology risk at scale. You’ll set the direction for control transformation and ensure CTOi is represented in the forums where decisions are made. The scope spans core technology domains and key third parties with a clear focus on improving control effectiveness. If this matches the impact you want to have we’d welcome your application.

Risk and Compliance is a global function that brings together all aspects of regulatory and financial crime risk management. Risk and Compliance (R&C) Assurance, as part of the Second Line of Defence (2LOD), provides independent Assurance on the design and operating effectiveness of the internal control environment to support HSBC in adherence to regulation, managing risk and achieving the desired conduct outcomes, in line with the Group’s risk appetite, internal standards and applicable regulatory expectations. R&C Assurance builds stakeholders confidence in sustainable growth by delivering outcome-focused Assurance on emerging risks and regulatory priorities. Through open collaboration and constructive challenges, R&C Assurance provides clear actionable insights that help protect our customers and maintain regulatory excellence.
People Responsibility: No
Reports To:  SVP and Head of Compliance Assurance, HSBC Bank (Taiwan) Limited (HBTW)
Role Purpose
This role is within Risk and Compliance Assurance covered both RC / FC Assurance reviews and the role holder is responsible for ensuring a high quality, well co-ordinated, insightful and consistent approach to testing across Business and Infrastructure Globally. The role contributes to the global standardised Assurance approach, ensuring that it is aligned to the bank’s Risk Management Framework (RMF). The role holder is responsible for driving efficient and high-quality end-to-end assurance work over RC /FC risks and controls across Taiwan bank and group where applicable.

- Key member of the Risk and Compliance Assurance/ FC Assurance team (Compliance Assurance HBTW will cover both RC and FC assurance reviews) ensuring that all standards, policies, procedures remain fit for purpose and subject to continuous assessment
- Provide relevant subject matter expertise to and work with immediate team, in the identification of appropriate review scope and delivery of assurance activities
- Inform Risk Owners, Control Owners and Risk Stewards of the design and operational effectiveness of the controls within their area of oversight and control
- Proactively monitor and identify key in-country and regional emerging risks and/or trends to ensure ongoing development of the assurance programme to address them
- Support the delivery of assurance reviews in line with the role and responsibility given in Assurance standard and RACI to ensure they are accurate and consistently of the right standards of quality and completeness to demonstrate the desired outcomes for HSBC and regulators
- Ensure consistent reporting and escalation of issues identified through RC and FC Assurance activities in a timely manner
- Operate within the RMF, aligning for example to risk assessment methodology and prioritization of risks, controls and issues

- Extensive knowledge of RC and FC risks and controls, with extensive experience in assurance or testing activities; Knowledge of financial services and able to demonstrate an understanding and appreciation of the challenges facing the global financial services industry and the changing regulatory landscape surrounding compliance organizations within the banking industry
- Min 7 years’ experience in business, compliance or audit/risk within financial industry. Strong risk assessment, control and testing skills and preferably audit related experience; Clear understanding of regulatory and financial crime compliance risk within the global financial services industry
- Excellent communicator with strong collaborative, inter-personal and influencing skills

Amanah Wholesale Banking (AWB) has a joint responsibility with Global Markets (GM) in managing HSBC Amanah Malaysia Berhad (HBMS)’ business within the ambit of GM. In relation to HBMS GM business, AWB will work jointly with GM on the overall business development and management of HBMS GM business. The ultimate ownership of the HBMS GM products remains with GM.

Business Development & Management
Assisting GM in development and management of HBMS GM business which includes (but not limited to):
- providing and executing strategic direction/initiatives on overall business development for HBMS GM
- where required, to represent HBMS in internal committees, forums and board of directors’ meetings in relation to GM business

Product Development & Management
AWB manages the development of new and maintain existing HBMS GM products in accordance to the relevant regulatory and HSBC guidelines. Development & management works include (but not limited to):

- setting up & updating operational processes

- Obtaining the required approvals (both internal and external), inclusive of Shariah approvals, if required

- promoting HBMS GM products through external engagements such as media interviews, press conference, conference, forums, seminars and awards nomination

Transaction Support
AWB will provide transaction support for the offering of HBMS GM products which include (but not limited to):

- assisting GM in obtaining required internal approvals for the purpose of transaction
- guiding treasury operations on the transaction execution (especially operational processes
- that are critical to maintaining shariah compliance) and
- assisting GM in post transaction review by Shariah department.

Others

- Implement measures to safeguard customer data, maintain confidentiality, and uphold the integrity of banking operations

Here at HSBC we use our unique expertise, capabilities, breadth and perspectives to open up new kinds of opportunity for our more than 40 million customers. We’re bringing together the people, ideas and capital that nurture progress and growth, helping to create a better world – for our customers, our people, our investors, our communities and the planet we all share.

Ready to grow trade finance solutions across Energy, Materials & Power?
Why HSBC
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organizations in the world. Guided by our purpose of opening up a world of opportunity, our ambition is to become the world’s most trusted bank globally, putting customers at the heart of everything we do.
The Opportunity
HSBC Global Trade Solutions (GTS) supports clients with a comprehensive range of structured and traditional trade products including supply chain finance, receivables and inventory finance, trade loans, letters of credit, guarantees and sustainable trade solutions. In this role you’ll own and manage a pipeline of new-to-trade and existing-to-trade opportunities within the Energy, Materials & Power sector. You’ll work through full sales cycles from prospecting through to deal closing and partner closely with Relationship Managers to identify client needs and shape solutions. Success means delivering tailored trade finance outcomes that meet client requirements while operating within regulatory frameworks. You’ll also help strengthen HSBC’s sector presence by staying close to industry and economic trends and engaging in relevant forums and events. Throughout, you’ll help protect the bank by ensuring deals meet credit risk, operational risk, compliance policies and client outcome standards.
What you'll be doing
- Own and manage a pipeline of new-to-trade and existing-to-trade client opportunities through full sales cycles
- Partner with Relationship Managers to identify needs and deliver tailored trade finance solutions aligned with client requirements and regulatory frameworks
- Structure proposals and client pitches that articulate commercial value and fit-for-purpose Structured Trade, Core Trade, and Commodity Trade solutions
- Coordinate with coverage teams, product specialists and implementation teams to deliver end-to-end commercial solutions
- Partner with risk and compliance functions to progress deals in line with credit, operational risk and compliance policies
- Engage with global GTS counterparts to align on solutions and execution across a matrixed environment
- Monitor industry, economic and regulatory trends to identify sector-specific opportunities for GTS growth
- Safeguard portfolio quality by ensuring client outcome standards are met across all transactions

What we're looking for
- Bring proven experience selling trade finance solutions across full sales cycles from prospecting to deal closing
- Experience with the Commodities Trade Finance market and structures, including structured borrowing bases
- Demonstrate strong capability shaping structured and traditional trade finance solutions to client needs
- Produce persuasive proposals and client pitches for senior stakeholders including C-suite clients
- Communicate clearly in writing and in person with senior internal and external stakeholders
- Use MS Excel and PowerPoint effectively to support commercial analysis and presentations
- Collaborate effectively across global matrixed teams including product, risk and implementation partners
- Work confidently across time zones and coordinate delivery across multiple internal stakeholders

Shaping GTS growth in Energy, Materials, & Power
This is a chance to build sector-focused momentum for HSBC Global Trade Solutions in one of the most dynamic client segments. The role offers visibility across coverage, product, implementation and global GTS partners with clear accountability for progressing opportunities from first conversation through to closing. If you’re ready to develop trade finance solutions that work for clients and stand up to regulatory and risk expectations we’d welcome your application.

As an HSBC employee, you will have access to tailored professional development opportunities to ensure you have the right skills for today and tomorrow. We offer a competitive pay and benefits package including a robust Wellness Hub, all in a welcoming and inclusive work environment. You will be empowered to drive HSBC’s engagement with the communities we serve through an industry-leading volunteerism policy, a generous matching gift program, and a comprehensive program of immersive Sustainability and Climate Change Initiatives. You’ll want to join our Employee Resource Groups as they play a central part in life at HSBC, including the development of our employees and networking inside and outside of HSBC. We value difference. We succeed together. We take responsibility. We get it done. And we want you to help us build the bank of the future!

jobs.description:
The opportunity: Asset Management Senior Risk Manager – Permanent contract

At HSBC, our purpose is opening up a world of opportunity and by joining our team, you can be part of something bigger. We are committed to removing barriers and ensuring careers at HSBC are inclusive and accessible.

Being part of HSBC in Luxembourg, you’ll help evolve and grow our Asset Management business. Do you have experience overseeing investment risks in a UCITS fund environment ? Are you confident interpreting regulatory requirements and strengthening risk-management frameworks ? Can you communicate effectively with senior stakeholders and provide practical, business-focused solutions?

If you answered yes to any of these questions, we want to hear from you!

What you will do:

HSBC Investment Funds Luxembourg (HIFL) is the management company for the Luxembourg-domiciled investment funds of HSBC Asset Management. As Senior Risk Manager, you will hold the permanent risk management function for UCITS with the CSSF. You will represent the Chief Risk Officer as a delegated representative at relevant committees and Board meetings, while serving as a trusted point of reference for risk and investment monitoring on Luxembourg and Irish market practices and regulatory risk matters.

Key responsibilities

- Oversee investment risks: Monitor market, liquidity, counterparty, sustainability and credit risks. Escalate concerns to senior management and provide reporting on findings.
- Strengthen the investment risk framework: Streamline HIFL’s risk processes, procedures, oversight framework and reporting, identifying practical opportunities for improvement.
- Strengthen the enterprise (entity) risk management framework: Provide 2 nd line of defense oversight and subject matter expertise. Constructively challenge how risks are managed to ensure aggregate exposure stays within appetite.
- Provide regulatory expertise: Assess assets eligibility under Luxembourg and Irish UCITS regulations, monitor regulatory developments, evaluate their impact on HIFL and recommend appropriate action plans.
- Lead governance and reporting: Prepare materials and documentation for the Local Management Committee, Risk Management Meeting and Investment Oversight Meeting; follow up actions with investment advisers and risk teams and actively participate in these forums.
- Represent HIFL externally: Deputise for the CRO at Luxembourg industry meetings, working groups and forums, acting as a senior representative on risk related matters.
- Support leadership and capability building: Help the CRO and Conducting Officer meet the regulatory reporting and risk-governance standards, while coaching and guiding junior colleagues on investment risk and investment restrictions monitoring.

You should apply if you have:

- Strong technical expertise in financial risk management, including VaR models and back-testing, stress testing, leverage, sustainability and liquidity risk measures.
- A sound understanding of financial instruments including the ability to constructively challenge active portfolio managers.
- Deep understanding of the Luxembourg fund industry, including the UCITS and AIFMD regulatory landscape, risk regulatory requirements and the obligations of a Luxembourg AIFM.
- Strong analytical, communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to present complex risk exposures clearly and build effective relationships.
- Good organizational skills and the ability to work both independently and as part of a team.
- A forward-looking and business-oriented mindset, with strong problem-solving skills.

Even if you feel you do not meet 100% of our qualifications, we encourage you to apply if you believe this role is right for you.

What you’ll get in return:

HSBC operates multiple variable pay plans, to reflect the diverse nature of the businesses, roles and markets in which we operate. Variable pay is designed to reward colleagues for their individual performance and contribution, as well as the performance of their relevant Business / Infrastructure, and the overall Group.

We offer a comprehensive and competitive package of benefits usually covering health support, life assurance, pension, and family friendly leaves, as well as many other benefits to support your wellbeing.

HSBC has been certified “Top Employer 2026” in Europe. This recognition from the Top Employers Institute rewards our HR practices and recognises HSBC as an HR Leader in France, Germany, Italy, Ireland, Luxembourg, The Netherlands, Poland and Spain.

jobs.description:
HSBC : notre mission est de créer un «  monde d’opportunités  ». Nous encourageons nos collaborateurs à partager leurs compétences et insuffler un changement positif pour la société. En outre, nous abordons nos activités à travers le prisme de l’inclusion et de l’accessibilité.

HSBC en France recrute chaque année des étudiants en stage ou en alternance et offre l’opportunité d’apprendre et gagner en expérience dans un contexte international. Ci-dessous plus de détails sur la mission concernée. N’hésitez pas à postuler !

Ce que vous allez faire :

Les clients suivis par l’équipe Institutional Client Group (ICG) - Banques, Assurances, Gestionnaires d’actifs liquides et illiquides ainsi que le Secteur public - constituent une clientèle prioritaire au sein de CIB.
La franchise ICG est constituée de deux piliers à l’échelle globale :
- Une composante « sectorielle », représentant c. 20% des clients institutionnels. Ces relations commerciales particulièrement développées sont suivies par des banquiers sectorisés profitant d’une proximité géographique avec les sièges de nos clients
- Une composante « portfolio managed » regroupant c. 80% du portefeuille ICG. Elément essentiel de la franchise ICG, l’équipe Institutional Portfolio Group (IPG) est en charge du suivi des clients en développement, à la fois :

- - Auprès des directions générales, avec des responsabilités de coverage sur l’ensemble du groupe
- En accompagnant les entités locales des principaux clients ICG.

Au sein de l’équipe IPG, le candidat choisi devra accompagner les chargés d’affaires dans le développement du fonds de commerce de façon profitable, en intervenant entre autres sur des sujets commerciaux, et de gestion de risques de crédit et de criminalité financière.

Le stage est à pourvoir pour 6 mois à temps plein à partir de janvier 2027, et est situé au 38 avenue Kléber, Paris 16.

Mission :

- Contribution à l’analyse financière et au montage des dossiers de crédits : présentation du client/prospect ; SWOT ; analyse financière et critique des bilans / comptes de résultat ; présentation des dossiers aux comités ad hoc ; mise en place des financements avec l’aide d’un chargé d’affaires (proposition client et négociation juridique)
- Coordination des lignes métiers (cash management, trade, salle des marchés, asset management, …) et des chargés d’affaires au sein des différentes géographies du groupe HSBC
- Préparation des rendez-vous clients et prospects : recherches sectorielles, financières et mise en place de présentations commerciales
- Gestion post rendez-vous clients : rédaction de comptes rendus ; mise en œuvre et suivi des actions commerciales
- Soutien à l’activité commerciale : gestions des appels entrants des clients, suivi des opérations ainsi que d’éventuelles réclamations.

Profil :

- Etudiant en école de commerce ou université (BAC +4/5), avec de solides connaissances acquises au cours de vos études sur l’analyse financière, la connaissance des produits et outils bancaire
- Durée de stage : 6 mois

- Doté(e) d’un tempérament commercial, dynamique, vous avez le sens de la vente et du service (développement commercial, prospection, ciblage, négociation)
- Organisé(e) et autonome, vous êtes capable de travailler en équipe, vous avez la volonté de vous impliquer dans la vie de l’entreprise
- Langue : Français et anglais niveau avancé.

Même si vous ne remplissez pas 100% des critères, nous vous encourageons à candidater si vous pensez que le rôle est fait pour vous !

Pourquoi rejoindre HSBC ?

Nous offrons un ensemble d’avantages compétitif, destinés à soutenir votre bien-être.

- Autonomie et flexibilité , notamment grâce à notre accord de télétravail
- Une politique de développement de carrière dynamique grâce à des programmes de développement, du mentorat, du coaching, et une offre de formation de qualité déployée par notre « HSBC University »
- Un accès à divers dispositifs permettant de garantir votre bien-être psychologique (yoga, sophrologie, Mindfulness, etc.)
- Des opportunités en France et à l’international car ce poste peut constituer un point de départ qui vous permettra ensuite d’évoluer au sein du Groupe
- Un environnement de travail qui favorise les thèmes de Diversité & Inclusion , et vous permet de travailler dans une atmosphère de support en étant vous-même

- Une carte tickets restaurants ou accès au restaurant d’entreprise selon votre lieu d’affectation

HSBC a été certifié « Top Employer 2026 » en Europe. Cette reconnaissance du « Top Employers Institute » récompense nos pratiques RH et nous reconnaît comme leader RH dans plusieurs pays d’Europe Continentale. HSBC est reconnu pour ses opportunités de développement professionnel, ses avantages sociaux et son environnement de travail inclusif.

Être ouvert à différents points de vue est important pour notre activité et pour l'ensemble de nos interlocuteurs. Chez HSBC, nous nous engageons à faire de notre environnement de travail un lieu inclusif en éliminant les obstacles et en veillant à ce que les carrières soient accessibles à tous.

International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB)    is our new global business combining Retail Banking and Wealth Management; and Global Private Banking, to become one of the world’s largest global wealth managers with USD1.4 trillion in assets.  Our dedicated colleagues serve millions of customers worldwide across the entire spectrum of private wealth, ranging from personal banking for individuals and families, through to business owners, investors and ultra-high-net-worth individuals.  We provide products and services such as bank accounts, credit cards, personal loans and mortgages, as well as asset management, insurance, wealth management and private banking, that best suit our customers’ needs.
We are currently seeking a high caliber professional to join our team as an  Business Development Associate – VNM.
Principal Accountabilities
Impact on the Business/Function
- Acquire new-to-bank customers via: Bank-led deployments (e.g., activations/roadshows), Customer referrals, Self-sourced prospecting

- Cross Sell Credit Cards, Personal Loans to existing and New to Bank customers
- Identify opportunities for Mortgages
- Migrate customers to use Digital solutions.

- Engage customers confidently, understand their needs, and convert opportunities using needs-based selling.
- Explain HSBC product features and benefits clearly and recommend suitable solutions.
- Support customers with account opening, coordinating with relevant departments to complete required steps.
- Manage post-application activities with internal stakeholders to ensure smooth processing and customer experience.
- Deliver assigned KPIs and maximise revenue contribution.
- Build positive, professional relationships with customers, stakeholders, and colleagues.

Maintain HSBC control standards and follow Group Compliance Policy to minimize operational risk by:
- Follow internal control standards, Audit requirements, Group requirements, and other internal guidelines.
- Ensure strict compliance with government banking regulations.
- Stay alert to operational risks across people/process/systems/external events (e.g., fraud, unauthorised activities, errors/omissions, inefficiencies, system failures).
- Escalate concerns to the line manager to assess impact, likelihood, and vulnerabilities.

Knowledge/Special Skills Requirements

- Minimum diploma holder and prefer 1–3 year experience ideally in sales/customer acquisition within banking or channel sales.
- Strong interest in sales and customer acquisition; proactive, target-driven, resilient in a fast-paced environment.
- Able to manage details and follow workflow/process steps accurately and efficiently.
- Able to work independently, multitask, work under pressure, and meet tight deadlines.
- Customer-oriented with strong communication skills; able to identify financial needs and refer appropriately.
- Competent in Microsoft Office.
- Fluent Vietnamese; English/Mandarin is an advantage
